shorts.title: GTA 6: Sell Cars to Moses in Chapter 2
shorts.description:
In GTA 6 Chapter 2, Moses buys stolen cars for $1,000 or more, guides say. No trackers, don't steal near his garage, and keep the damage down.

shorts.title: GTA 6: 3 Things the Game Doesn't Tell You
shorts.description:
GTA 6 has no mission replays (save first), some story missions wait until you've earned more cash, and auto drive takes you to your waypoint.
